Due to a permanent infrastructure limitation, there exists no direct transport link between Hub Alpha and Hub Beta.  
Furthermore, owing to regulatory and scheduling considerations, the tour must incorporate exactly one of two specified critical links: either the route connecting Hub Beta and Hub Gamma, or the route connecting Hub Gamma and Hub Delta.  

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a closed loop that visits every hub precisely once and concludes at the initial hub.
